technical_and_design_decisions: All ported modules will adhere to Spring Cloud Stream's existing module structure, coding conventions, and dependency management aligned with Spring Boot 3.x and Spring Framework 6.x (requiring Java 17+ as specified).

The BinderFactory abstraction will be implemented as a Spring-managed pluggable interface using dependency injection for runtime binder resolution, with no breaking changes to existing public binder configuration APIs.
Composed job removal (U6) and ZK metadata storage (U7) exploration will leverage existing Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Integration components to minimize new code and rework.
All ported processor modules will use the same message conversion and serialization logic as existing s-c-s processor modules to ensure cross-module consistency.
The script module will support all JVM-native scripting languages (Groovy, Kotlin, JavaScript) natively without requiring additional custom language runtime integrations.
assumptions: Full source code and documentation for the existing Spring XD modules (json-to-tuple, object-to-json, script, shell, splitter) are available for porting with no licensing restrictions preventing reuse in the s-c-s repository.

The s-c-s repository already has established base infrastructure (parent build configuration, base test utilities, CI/CD pipelines) in place, so no effort is required for core project scaffolding setup.

The ZooKeeper client dependency and existing ZK metadata storage utilities are already included in the s-c-s project, so no new external dependencies are required for the composed job ZK storage exploration (U7).
Existing binder implementations in s-c-s can be extended to support the BinderFactory abstraction without requiring breaking changes to public APIs used by existing consumers.
The composed job functionality targeted for removal (U6) has no active downstream dependencies in the current s-c-s codebase, so removal will not impact existing user workloads.
All ported and new code will meet the project's existing test coverage requirement of minimum 80% line coverage.

Adapt existing Spring XD object-to-json module source code to s-c-s repository standards, update dependencies, implement required processor interfaces, add required tests, update module documentation.

Adapt existing Spring XD script module source code to s-c-s, update dependencies, ensure support for JVM-native scripting languages (Groovy, Kotlin, JavaScript), implement required processor interfaces, add unit and integration tests including script execution edge case coverage, update module documentation.

Adapt existing Spring XD shell module source code to s-c-s, update dependencies, implement required processor interfaces, add tests for shell command execution and error handling scenarios, update module documentation.
